title: Resource Estimation for Fault-Tolerant Quantum Programs
summary: Fault-tolerant quantum computation enables the deployment of practical quantum algorithms but incurs substantial overhead from error correction, making resource estimation a central concern. Beyond case-by-case analyses, existing quantum programming languages either require programmers to manipulate low-level hardware details, rendering fault-tolerant implementations cumbersome, or abstract away the underlying error-correction schemes, reducing the effectiveness of resource utilization and estimation.
